incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — Service: inference-api — Symptom: p99 latency > 1200ms over 5m — Route: /v1/generate — SLO: p99 < 800ms — Pager: oncall@redwood — Incident ID: INC-20260314-01
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered escalation level 1 — Notify: Alice Nguyen — Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260314-01

Alice Nguyen: ack — looking now. What’s the impact? :eyes:
Raj Patel: ack — I'm jumping in to check autoscaling and GPU pool metrics.
María López: on standby for customer comms — which customers are seeing errors/timeouts?
Alice Nguyen: dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/inference/INC-20260314-01 — p95=420ms, p99=1.4s, error rate unchanged (~0.2%) — latency tail increased.
Raj Patel: `kubectl get hpa -n inference` shows `inference-pool` at desired 4, current 4, CPU ~85%, GPU util 95% on a couple hosts — autoscaler didn't add because cooldown? digging.
Jordan (SRE Lead): pinging infra — any recent deploy? @eng-runtime
incident-bot: Deploy bot: 2026-03-14T08:01Z — Deploy ID dpl-20260314-873 — runtime-service — user: ci/cd — status: success
Alice Nguyen: could be KV cache churn or large seq lengths. Rollup: samples show spike of up to 8k tokens on some requests.
Raj Patel: grabbing tail traces... `trace-id: 0a3f...` — KV cache miss rate jumped 22% in last 10m.
María López: Customer-impact: a handful of mid-market customers reported degraded UX, no 5xxs. Notified PDs on high-traffic tenants.
Alice Nguyen: mitigation plan:
  1) scale inference pool from 4 -> 8 nodes (manual) — reduces queueing
  2) enable traffic split to smaller model variant `redwood-medium` for background/batch requests
  3) temporarily lower max_batch_size to 1 for latency-sensitive routes
Raj Patel: executing step 1: `infractl scale pool inference-pool --replicas 8` — started
Raj Patel: step 1 done — new nodes registering, initial balancer ripples — monitoring.
incident-bot: autoscaler note: manual scale overrides enabled by current maintenance window.
Alice Nguyen: step 2: updating routing policy to split 20% to `redwood-medium` for requests with `x-priority: low` — patch applied.
María López: sending customer note to affected tenants: "We're mitigating a latency degradation; routing adjustments underway. Will follow up with root cause."
Raj Patel: step 3: lowered `max_batch_size` from 16 -> 1 on `route:/v1/generate` — applied via configmap, rolling restart of 2 pods required — restarted.
Alice Nguyen: metrics 2m after changes: p95=260ms, p99=580ms — still above target but much improved. Continued monitoring.
Jordan (SRE Lead): great. any sign of underlying regression vs load change?
Raj Patel: retrospective: CPU was fine, latency correlates with KV cache backend latency (redis cluster) — increased latency to redis from 4ms -> 120ms causing decode stalls.
incident-bot: Redis alert: redis-cluster latency spike detected — incident attached: REDIS-20260314-A
María López: escalating to infra-db team for redis. @infra-db
Alice Nguyen: for now, continue with scaled pool. Can we add read replica for redis? @infra-db
Alice Nguyen: handoff: my shift ends in 35m — Raj, can you own the stabilization and prepare notes? I'll summarize for postmortem and customer follow-up.
Raj Patel: take it. I'll keep monitoring, keep scaling if necessary, and await infra-db fix. I'll also add an alert to detect KV miss rate increase earlier.
María López: I'll follow up with customers and add a summary to the incident channel.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-20260314-01 acknowledged by Alice Nguyen at 2026-03-14T08:05Z
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation to level 2 — Notifying: Jordan (SRE Lead)
Jordan (SRE Lead): acknowledged — joining monitoring.
Alice Nguyen: final note before handoff: p99 trend is improving but redis backend still elevated — logging reproduction dataset to /mnt/incidents/1782504321/trace-0a3f.log
Raj Patel: logging actions and timelines to incident runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/1782504321
María López: scheduled follow-up update in 30m to customers and postmortem owner assignment.
Jordan (SRE Lead): acknowledged. good job team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-01 — mitigations in place, status: stabilizing — will remain open until redis latency returns to baseline.
